4. Set up automatic online backups for your entire business website.
5. Store business passwords in a secure online manager so a dead computer never locks you out.

A reliable website keeps your business moving no matter what happens to your hardware.

linkedin.text:
Ever hired someone to build your website, only to feel locked out when you asked for the login details?

It happens to local business owners all the time. An agency builds your site, but they keep the keys. When you want to update your clinic details or add new boutique items, you are stuck waiting for them.

Before you hire anyone for your website, keep these simple rules in mind:

3. Build for today, plan for tomorrow. Get what your shop needs now, but ensure another builder can easily add features later if you expand.
4. Budget for light check-ups. Websites need small regular check-ups to stay fast and secure.
